record.final_answer:
18 GB.

That's from the Ferrocache 5.2 sizing guide I recorded (docs.ferrocache.example/sizing): maxmemory bounds only the dataset, so replication buffers, client output buffers and fragmentation come on top. The rule is RAM ≥ 1.25× maxmemory without replication and ≥ 1.5× with it — 12 GB × 1.5 = 18 GB for your replica node.
